title: Area Moment of Inertia - Typical Cross Sections II
description: Area Moment of Inertia, Moment of Inertia for an Area or Second Moment of Area for typical cross section profiles including angles with equal/unequal legs, triangles, and rectangular triangles.

rows: c = yt·cos(45°), yt = (h² + ht + t²) / (2(2h - t)·cos(45°))
Ix = 1/3 (t(h - yd)³ + b·yd³ - b1(yd - t)³); Iy = 1/3 (t(b - xd)³ + h·xd³ - h1(xd - t)³)
b = base, h = height, ba = a dimension, bc = c dimension
